name: Cementless THR - Head & Neck Assemblies
description: Modular head-neck assembly for Vetmaster Cementless THR. Surface-treated Ti-Alloy neck with CoCrMo, Oxidized Zirconium (Zr-Nb), or Ceramic head options. Pairs with Vetmaster dual-mobility Inlay (ordered separately) for complete assembly.
